title: Session Tags Metadata
description: Stages and point-event tags captured by record for an entire recording session. CPU timestamps use CLOCK_REALTIME nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

type.description: Versioned document-type identifier for session-level tags.

generated_at.description: Local civil time at which this metadata document was written, in the timestamp format emitted by dvrk_data.

stages.description: Ordered recording intervals. Repeated stage names represent separate occurrences.

name.description: Stage label configured for the recording session.

cpu_ts.description: Stage-start CLOCK_REALTIME timestamp in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

generated_at.description: Local civil time at which the stage start was recorded.

cpu_ts.description: Stage-end CLOCK_REALTIME timestamp in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

generated_at.description: Local civil time at which the stage end was recorded.

tags.description: Point-event tags keyed by configured tag name. Each value is the ordered list of occurrences.

items.description: One occurrence of a session event tag.

cpu_ts.description: Event CLOCK_REALTIME timestamp in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

generated_at.description: Local civil time at which the event tag was recorded.
